output.summary: A climbing cactus native to Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Nicaragua, Panama, Peru, Trinidad and Tobago, and Venezuela, yellow dragonfruit has exceptionally large night-blooming flowers. Its spiny yellow fruit has edible white flesh with a pleasant, mildly sweet flavour; hybrids may have differently coloured skin or flesh.
output.edibilityNote: The fruit’s white interior is edible and mildly sweet; hybrid fruit may have pink flesh.
